label: N8560-48BC 25G/100G data-centre leaf switch
description: FS N8560-48BC 1U ToR leaf switch - 48x 25G/10G SFP28 ports and 8x 100G/40G QSFP28 uplinks, non-blocking, with VXLAN/EVPN, M-LAG, PFC/ECN, redundant hot-swap PSUs and fans. Managed over CLI, SNMPv1/v2c/v3 and NETCONF; one MGMT port and one console port.
notes: Port list confirmed against FS's own N8560-48BC datasheet (the PDF this spec cites): `48x 25G ports and 8x 100G ports`, 1U, with MGMT and console in the manageability list. The 25G ports accept 10G SFP+ modules and the 100G ports accept 40G QSFP+, which is what the datasheet's `48 10G/25G and 8 40/100G` means; no 4x25G breakout is claimed because the datasheet does not state one. Ports carry the media they present (`sfp28-1..48`, `qsfp28-1..8`) rather than a NOS interface name: FS does not publish the CLI naming for this model, and inventing it would be a fact the datasheet does not contain. Console is a serial port, not a data interface, so it is not modelled.
